newsitem.title: CANADA: Bombardier gets C$78 mln U.K. contract.
newsitem.headline: Bombardier gets C$78 mln U.K. contract.

text.p: Bombardier Inc said on Monday that it was awarded a C$78 million contract to make 24 light rail vehicles (LRVs) for South London Croydon Tramlink in Britain.
The contract was awarded to Bombardier Prorail, a subsidiary of Bombarier Eurorail, based in Wakefield, England. Bombardier will also be responsible for maintaining the vehicles.
The order was part of a C$448 million contract awarded to Tramtrack Croydon Ltd to implement a light rail transit system in the suburbs of South London, Bombardier said.
Tramtrack Croydon was also granted a 99-year concession to operate and maintain the 28-kilometre rail system, which was scheduled to open at the end of 1999.

Bombardier Eurorail is a shareholder in Tramtrack Croydon. Other shareholders are system operator Centre West, construction firms Sir Robert McAlpine and Amery Construction and finance partners 3i Group Plc and Royal Bank of Scotland Plc .
